ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ is the genitive complement of construct غَيْبَ.
ٱلْأَرْضِ is coordinated with ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ in the genitive construct.
بَصِيرٌ is the predicate of ٱللَّهُ in the closing nominal sentence.
مَا is governed by بِ as the scope complement of بَصِيرٌ.
مَا is the object within the relative clause تَعْمَلُونَ.
